question: Who penned the novel "Last Man in Tower"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravind Adiga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Aravind Adiga**, an acclaimed Indian author, penned the novel "**Last Man in Tower**," which was published in **2011**.

• The book is set in the city of **Mumbai** and explores themes of urbanization, greed, and morality.

• "Last Man in Tower" revolves around the residents of Vishram Society, a housing cooperative, and their struggle when a real estate developer offers a buyout deal.

• **Aravind Adiga** is best known for his debut novel "**The White Tiger**," which won the prestigious **Man Booker Prize** in **2008**.
